messages:
sam-docs: Quick heads up — opening a small docs PR to add locale fallback examples and a short data-residency redirect note. PTAL if anyone owns links/footnotes.

maria-eng: thanks! can you paste the snippet you plan to add? want to make sure it matches the runtime behavior (region header + fallback).

sam-docs: sure — thinking of a short example and a tiny redirect note. snippet: 
```http
GET /v1/generate?model=gpt-xx&locale=es-MX HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1
```
and a note: "If a model/region isn't available for the requested locale, requests are routed to a compatible region variant and a 302 redirect header may be returned to indicate the chosen endpoint. See data residency footnote."

jon-infra: small correction — we don't return 302 for internal routing. We set X-Redwood-Routed-Region on the response and preserve the request endpoint unless caller asks for strict residency. If strict residency is requested we return 409 + guidance.

sam-docs: ah that's important, thanks. I'll change the language. New plan: show SDK snippet that sets strict residency and show both behaviours.

sam-docs: SDK snippet idea (JS):
```js
const res = await client.generate({
  model: 'gpt-xx',
  locale: 'es-MX',
  residency: { strict: true } // returns 409 if unavailable
});
```

maria-eng: looks good. One nit: the header name in the SDK is `residency.strict` not `residency: { strict: true }` in v0.9 — but we can show both quick examples and call out version.

sam-docs: ok i'll add two tiny snippets and a compatibility note. Also adding a single sentence about the fallback header: `X-Redwood-Routed-Region` on the response indicates where the request actually ran.

harry-legal: please add the standard residency footnote for customer data: "Requests routed outside the requested residency may process metadata outside the requested region unless strict residency is enforced." Keep it short.

sam-docs: will do. drafting PR now: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4821 — includes: 1) locale fallback paragraph, 2) two SDK snippets (v0.9 and v1.0), 3) footnote.

maria-eng: ping me on the PR for wording around headers. I'll confirm runtime accuracy.

jon-infra: also add a quick link to the routing policies page (internal) so readers can find details on strict vs best-effort residency.

sam-docs: good call — linking to /docs/routing-policies (internal).

docs-bot: CI check: markdown lint and linkcheck passed for changed files in PR #4821.

sam-docs: awesome — adding harry's exact footnote text and maria/jon suggestions, will merge after +2 from eng + compliance ack.

harry-legal: acked. thanks for keeping it concise. :thumbsup:

maria-eng: +1 (will drop a quick comment on the response-header sentence).

sam-docs: merging in ~30m after CI finishes. thanks everyone for the quick reviews! :rocket:
